en.text:
Enhances your <solar/>Healing, Firebolt, Solar, and Fusion Grenade Abilities:

• <solar/>Healing Grenades grant <solar/>Cure x2 and <solar/>Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with <solar/>Ember of Solace)
• <solar/>Firebolt Grenades gain 50% increased search radius (8🠚12 Meters) and targets 5 enemies (up from 4).
• <solar/>Solar Grenades last 2 seconds longer and release 'Molten Lava Orbs' that deal additional damage.
• <solar/>Fusion Grenades detonate a second time after 0.5 seconds, dealing additional damage in an 8 meter radius.
